title: Construct the positive channel without losing higher-dimensional sectors
statement: Whole A_j B_j pair symmetry,graded module duality and Bell-surjective positive completion give the reported exact constructive branch.

evidence.quote: P1 human-directed stop and strongest-result recovery — complete response

Explicit exact rational-complex Choi J_Gamma>=0,Tr_B J=I,arbitrary finite input/output dimensions a,b,including SINGULAR support S=range J. No noisy-tomography input. Complete means the specified maximal/RLD family,not all communication tasks. provides: D_k is dual to degree-k part of M=(P tensor R*)/N. Losing a local direction means a nonzero degree-one element killed by all sufficiently high-degree monomials. All-order condition earns prescribed Bell surjectivity and strictly positive completion.

Full local support at ONE order does not imply Bell surjectivity at that same order;retained counterexample prevents a stronger claim. Symmetric/bosonic distinction in higher dimensions is paid by whole-pair construction.

Source fixes channel/dimensions/coefficients for polynomial-in-NUMERICAL-k compressed certificate and deterministic circuit;expanded physical receiver registers and all environments/ancillas/gates paid. No varying-dimension general polynomial claim.
